description: Latest press releases from EIN Presswire's public news sitemap (source: einpresswire.com). Returns headline, published time, keyword tags and geo location for each release, newest first. Covers roughly the trailing 48 hours across every category — not a full archive, and not the gated RSS feeds.

since_hours.description: Only return releases published within the last N hours (optional, max ~48).

name: einpresswire_latest_releases
